title: Analytic normality for an adically complete minimal normal quotient
statement: For any commutative Noetherian ring $D$ [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], define $N(D)$ as follows: for every pair of prime ideals $\mathfrak a\subseteq\mathfrak b$ of $D$, and every finite purely inseparable extension $E/\kappa(\mathfrak a)$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension], the ring $E\otimes_D\widehat{D_{\mathfrak b}}$ is normal [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]. Here $\kappa(\mathfrak a)=\operatorname{Frac}(D/\mathfrak a)$, $D_{\mathfrak b}$ is localization at the prime [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], $\widehat{D_{\mathfrak b}}=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}D_{\mathfrak b}/(\mathfrak bD_{\mathfrak b})^n$ is its maximal-ideal-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], and $D\to E$ factors through $D/\mathfrak a$. Let $T$ be a commutative Noetherian normal domain that is Nagata [def-weil-pbc-nagata-ring], and let $J\subsetneq T$ be a nonzero ideal such that $T$ is $J$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Assume that $N(T/H)$ holds for every nonzero proper ideal $H\subsetneq T$. Then for every prime ideal $\mathfrak t\subset T$, the maximal-ideal-adic completion $\widehat{T_{\mathfrak t}}$ is a normal domain.

source.place: Theorem 5.1 Step 1 (1-4), p.8, quoting Nishimura–Nishimura, Ideal-adic completion of Noetherian rings II, Theorem A (pp.453–467). Agent-isolated normal-domain subcase with every nonzero quotient already having normal formal fibres; the original proof of Theorem A is WANTED, not present in literature/. This node records only that restricted analytic-normality input, not the full lifting theorem.
